MInstanceID.description: Identifier of the M-Instance (Virtual Space) associated with this AMS-HCI Message.

UEnvironmentID.description: Identifier of the U-Environment (Real Space) associated with this AMS-HCI Message.

AMSHCIMessageID.description: Unique identifier of this AMS-HCI Message instance.

AMSHCIMessageTime.description: Time this AMS-HCI Message was produced.

AMSHCIMessageSpaceTime.description: Time this AMS-HCI Message was sent.

HCIMessage.description: Data in message from HCI to AMS.

RequestedRoutes.description: List of requested Routes with Stops.

OfflineMapID.description: Identifier of the reference Offline Map.

SelectedRouteID.description: Identifier of the Route selected by the passenger.

RouteCommand.description: Command to apply to the current Route.

StreamPointOfView.description: Request to stream the M-Location corresponding to a human-specified U-Location via Point of View.

ULocation.description: U-Location from which the passenger wishes to observe the environment.

AMSMessage.description: Data in message from AMS to HCI.

RouteList.description: List of candidate Routes provided in response to an HCI request.

RouteStatus.description: State of the Route the CAV was commanded to drive: in answer to a Route Command, and on arrival.

RouteID.description: Identifier of the Route this state refers to.

Status.description: Executing: the CAV drives the Route; Suspended: halted, to be resumed; Stopped: halted, the Route abandoned; Arrived: stopped at the Route's destination.

FailureID.description: Identifier of a CAV equipment failure condition (e.g. battery low, mechanical failure).

DataXMData.description: MPAI-PTF Data Exchange Metadata providing provenance, authorisation, legal, security, and confidence information associated with this AMS-HCI Message in a trusted data exchange context.

DescrMetadata.description: Human-readable descriptive metadata of the AMS-HCI Message (plain text, max 2048 characters).
